title: Brews a good cup of tea but so many steps & a separate timer are needed; NOT worth it
text:
Brews a good cup of tea but so many steps & a separate timer are needed; NOT worth it. I am a tea connoisseur that loves loose leaf teas to be brewed correctly and at the right temperature. Unless one brews only black or pu-erh tea or herbal tisanes, then a brewer that brews at different temperatures is required in order to extract the correct flavor profile of that tea. This is where this Breville BTM500 Smart Tea Infuser is supposed to shine. After having tried this brewer, it does brew the tea correctly but it is so cumbersome to use and there are so many steps involved that it is not worth the price, in my opinion.

Before I go into the PROs and CONS of this particular teapot, I want to explain a little bit about the tools I use now to brew tea.

My favorite pot is a [[ASIN:B003LNOPSG Breville One-Touch Tea Maker]]. I originally purchased one of those at $250 and then purchased a second one for $199.99 because I felt I could not live without it if the first one broke. It is is the only tea brewer I know of that does a phenomenal job of brewing tea that is to be enjoyed to the last drip and brews with the least hassle. However, if I only want one cup of tea, I use the much simpler [[ASIN:B00DHLAC66 Frigidaire Professional Programmable Water Kettle]] to heat water to the correct temperature for one cup of tea.

I also occasionally use a tea kettle to just boil water to brew one cup of black tea with a tea infuser. When I want more than one cup of black tea, I use the [[ASIN:B007UEEJVK Nesco TM-1 Teamaker, 1-Liter]] which acts like a coffee pot but for tea and only brews with boiling water.

Although this Smart Tea Infuser does produce a high quality brew, there is just not enough good about it compared to the bad.

WHAT I LOVE:
- It brews a good cup of tea of varying kinds at the appropriate temperatures.

- Water can be boiled in this.

- There is a cord storage underneath the base.

- This is an attractive tea maker that looks great on my counter top.

WHAT I DISLIKE (in order of my biggest hate):
- Brewing the tea requires several steps. First the kettle needs to be filled with the desired amount of water. Second, the lid rim and top need to be inserted. Third, the tea type / temperature need to be selected. Then the unit needs to be turned on (a.k.a. started). Fourth, once the unit beeps (which takes several long minutes), the tea basket has to be inserted with the correct amount of tea. Fifth, the steeping time has to be set and then the START TIMER button pressed to start steeping. However, there is no light on that button to indicate it was even pressed. Once the cycle is complete, the tea maker is supposed to beep three times. I was unable to get it to beep. This means I now have to time how long I am steeping it for with a separate timer or sit and watch until the other lights on the pot go out. Now the tea can be enjoyed but it is important to remove the tea basket first so it does not over steep. After the tea is poured, I have to follow more steps to keep it warm. I have to return the tea kettle to power base and press and hold the TEMP / KEEP WARM button for two seconds. This will keep the tea warm for 30 minutes unless I remove the kettle, after which I have to reset.

- The long brew basket makes it difficult to remove the spent leaves from the basket.

- The unit does not remember the last settings chosen after a power off.

- Custom programming is not possible as there is only a set selection of temperatures.

- There is no auto start option. This means one cannot wake up to a freshly brewed cup of tea. For the price of this unit, I would have expected this.

- The current cost of $149 is way too expensive for the cumbersome features of this brewer. I recommend spending $50 more to buy the [[ASIN:B003LNOPSG Breville One-Touch Tea Maker]]. Perhaps this is Breville's way of getting people to buy their one touch by making a substandard tea infuser.

- There is no secondary strainer at the spout of the carafe to catch any wayward leaves from escaping into my cup; although, this is unlikely given the tight "weave" of the brew basket.

- The base (obviously) and the carafe itself (that needs special care of wiping down or rinsing gently inside only) cannot be washed. This is the same with their one-touch tea maker.

MORE DISAPPOINTMENTS
- The quick start guide and instruction manual contradict each other. The quick start guide says to leave the tea basket in when cleaning for first use; the instruction manual says to remove it. The quick start guides forgets to tell you about selecting the steep time and has you just starting the timer.

- The instruction manual contains erroneous tea information. Most tea is oxidized (exposed to air) and not fermented (converted via use of microbes). Although some use those words interchangeably, they do not mean the same thing and there is a lot of misinformation out in the tea world about this.

In summary, this is definitely not worth the purchase. There are entirely too many steps required to achieve the perfect brew. The tea basket is too long and narrow which makes it difficult to empty. In addition, the unit does not beep three times when the steeping time is over as the manual says. If you just love different loose leaf teas and want to experience the various subtleties in the liquor of these different brews, then save for the [[ASIN:B003LNOPSG Breville One-Touch Tea Maker]] because that tea maker is worth it and this one does not even come close.

product_metadata.title: Breville BTM500CLR Smart Tea Infuser Compact Tea Maker, Brushed Stainless Steel 8.3" X 8.3" X 9.3"
features: TREAT TEA RIGHT: Unlock the flavor potential of your humble cup of tea with the Breville Smart Tea Infuser Compact. Control the temperature, set your steep time and then rediscover your favorite blend.
5 PRESETS TO SUIT YOUR TEA: 5 different temperature settings suitable for Green, White, Oolong, Herbal & Black teas.

VARIABLE STEEP TIME: Set your steep time from 1 to 5 minutes for mild, medium or strong tea. Whichever suits your taste. Timer beeps when ideal steeping time lapses, so you will know when to remove the tea basket.
COMPACT CAPACITY: 34 oz. / 4 Cup jug and tea capacity.
EASY TO USE AND CLEAN: The 1-touch magnetic detachment allows for easy and safe tea basket removal.
HOT WATER BOILER: Need to boil water for another reason? No problem, it will boil hot water for other drinks.
DISHWASHER SAFE TEA BASKET: Stainless Steel Tea basket can be washed in your dishwasher.
description: The Breville Smart tea infuser compactright temperature & steep time for your tea.
